ety.text: Borrowed from Old Church Slavonic благодьньствие (blagodĭnĭstvije). By surface analysis, бла́го (blágo) + -о- (-o-) + день (denʹ) + -ство (-stvo) + -ие (-ije).

ety.text: Inherited from Old East Slavic передати (peredati), from Proto-Slavic *perdati, from *per- + *dati. By surface analysis, пере- (pere-) + дать (datʹ). Doublet of преда́ть (predátʹ), a borrowing from Old Church Slavonic.

ety.text: Inherited from Proto-Slavic *plǫtati. Compare Belarusian плу́таць (plútacʹ), Polish plątać and Ukrainian плу́тати (plútaty).
